cond_0001.intro:

cond_0101.intro:
The Senior Import / Export Analyst will provide expertise for Trade Compliance export and/or import activities and may act as a trainer and mentor of Trade Compliance Analysts and Specialists. Assists in the classification or licensing of products for export and/or import, ensuring compliance with applicable regulations, and releasing export compliance-related holds on shipments after all Trade Compliance requirements are satisfied.
The Senior Import / Export Analyst will maintain working knowledge of all applicable export/import regulations, providing updates to management regarding current and pending compliance regulation initiatives and legislation that may affect company business, ensuring various registrations with government agencies are kept up to date as required by regulations. Supports Trade Compliance Management at the site, Regional or Global level with Trade Compliance issues, such as Export License Determination and End User documentation.

The role involves classifying and licensing products for export and/or import, staying in close contact with relevant teams to ensure compliance with applicable regulations, and releasing export compliance-related holds on shipments after all Trade Compliance requirements are satisfied.
The Senior Import / Export Analyst will maintain working knowledge of all applicable export/import regulations, actively communicating updates to management regarding current and pending compliance regulation initiatives and legislation that may affect company business, and ensuring various registrations with government agencies are kept up to date as required by regulations. The role supports Trade Compliance Management at the site, Regional or Global level, regularly engaging with stakeholders on Trade Compliance issues such as Export License Determination and End User documentation.

Strong organizational skills
Strong attention to detail

Assists in the classification or licensing of products for export and/or import, ensuring compliance with applicable regulations, and releasing export compliance-related holds on shipments after all Trade Compliance requirements are satisfied.
The Senior Import / Export Analyst will maintain working knowledge of all applicable export/import regulations, providing updates to management regarding current and pending compliance regulation initiatives and legislation that may affect company business, ensuring various registrations with government agencies are kept up to date as required by regulations. Assists in the classification or licensing of products for export and/or import, ensuring compliance with applicable regulations, and releasing export compliance-related holds on shipments after all Trade Compliance requirements are satisfied.
The Senior Import / Export Analyst will maintain working knowledge of all applicable export/import regulations, providing updates to management regarding current and pending compliance regulation initiatives and legislation that may affect company business, ensuring various registrations with government agencies are kept up to date as required by regulations. Supports Trade Compliance Management at the site, Regional or Global level with Trade Compliance issues, such as Export License Determination and End User documentation. Most people become stronger in this kind of trade compliance work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience

Strong attention to detail
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Strong computer skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access, Outlook, Team, web browsers, and database management tools
Preferred Requirements
Strong organizational skills
Problem-solving skills, analyzing possible solutions with technical expertise, judgment, and precedents

Assists in the classification or licensing of products for export and/or import, ensuring compliance with applicable regulations, and releasing export compliance-related holds on shipments after all Trade Compliance requirements are satisfied.
The Senior Import / Export Analyst will maintain working knowledge of all applicable export/import regulations, providing updates to management regarding current and pending compliance regulation initiatives and legislation that may affect company business, ensuring various registrations with government agencies are kept up to date as required by regulations. Supports Trade Compliance Management at the site, Regional or Global level with Trade Compliance issues, such as Export License Determination and End User documentation.

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field required; advanced degree strongly preferred
Advanced knowledge of trade compliance regulations in the designated region, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Export Administration Regulations (EAR), Foreign Assets Control Regulations (FACR), Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC), and [Location masked] Customs and Border Protection Regulations
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
Demonstrated expertise in problem-solving, analyzing possible solutions with technical judgment and precedents
Strong command of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access, Outlook, Teams, web browsers, and database management tools
Preferred Requirements
Exceptional organizational skills with a proven ability to manage competing priorities under pressure
Strong attention to detail with a consistent track record of accuracy in a compliance-driven environment
Strong presentation skills with the ability to communicate complex regulatory topics clearly to varied audiences
Demonstrated ability to multi-task and manage workload effectively across multiple concurrent compliance activities
